arxiv-2102-12176.title: A Nonlinear Formulation of Radiation Stress and Applications to Cnoidal Shoaling
arxiv-2102-12176.creator: Martin O. Paulsen ⋅ \cdot Henrik Kalisch
arxiv-2102-12176.description: Abstract In this article we provide formulations of energy flux and radiation stress consistent with the scaling regime of the Korteweg-de Vries (KdV) equation. These quantities can be used to describe the shoaling of cnoidal waves approaching a gently sloping beach.

arxiv-2105-10384.title: FRaGenLP: A Generator of Random Linear Programming Problems for Cluster Computing Systems
arxiv-2105-10384.creator: Leonid B. Sokolinsky✉, Irina M. Sokolinskaya
arxiv-2105-10384.description: Abstract The article presents and evaluates a scalable FRaGenLP algorithm for generating random linear programming problems of large dimension n n on cluster computing systems. To ensure the consistency of the problem and the boundedness of the feasible region, the constraint system includes 2 ​ n + 1 2n+1 standard inequalities, called support inequalities.

arxiv-2108-09268.title: Renormalization group analysis of near-field induced dephasing of optical spin waves in an atomic medium
arxiv-2108-09268.creator: S. Grava, Y. He, S. Wu, D. E. Chang
arxiv-2108-09268.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by S. Grava, Y. He, S. Wu, D. E. Chang. While typical theories of atom-light interactions treat the atomic medium as being smooth, it is well-known that microscopic optical effects driven by atomic granularity, dipole-dipole interactions, and multiple scattering can lead to important effects. Recently, for example, it was experimentally observed that these ingredients can lead to a fundamental, density-dependent dephasing of optical spin waves in a disordered atomic medium.

arxiv-2206-05272.title: Optimizing the Mean Swimming Velocity of a Model Two-sphere Swimmer
arxiv-2206-05272.creator: B. U. Felderhof
arxiv-2206-05272.description: Abstract The swimming of a two-sphere system oscillating in a viscous fluid is studied on the basis of simplified equations of motion which take account of both friction and inertial effects. In the model the friction follows from an Oseen approximation to the mobility matrix, and the inertial effects follow from a dipole approximation to the added mass matrix.

arxiv-2310-07344.title: Probing solutions to the S 8 S_{8} tension with galaxy clustering
arxiv-2310-07344.creator: Pedro Carrilho a, Chiara Moretti b,c,a, Maria Tsedrik a
arxiv-2310-07344.description: Abstract The current discrepancy between the CMB and weak lensing measurements of the amplitude of matter fluctuations, the so-called S 8 S_{8} tension, has attracted a great deal of recent attention, as it may show a crack in the Λ \Lambda CDM model of cosmology.

arxiv-2407-00009.title: An Open-Source Fast Parallel Routing Approach for Commercial FPGAs
arxiv-2407-00009.creator: Xinshi Zang, Wenhao Lin, Shiju Lin, Jinwei Liu, Evangeline F.Y. Young
arxiv-2407-00009.description: Abstract . In the face of escalating complexity and size of contemporary FPGAs and circuits, routing emerges as a pivotal and time-intensive phase in FPGA compilation flows. In response to this challenge, we present an open-source parallel routing methodology designed to expedite routing procedures for commercial FPGAs.

arxiv-2511-13870.title: Just Few States are Enough: Randomized Sparse Feedback for Stability of Dynamical Systems
arxiv-2511-13870.creator: Zaid Hadach, Hajar El Hammouti, El Houcine Bergou, Adnane Saoud
arxiv-2511-13870.description: Abstract While classical control theory assumes that the controller has access to measurements of the entire state (or output) at every time instant, this paper investigates a setting where the feedback controller can only access a randomly selected subset of the state vector at each time step.

pmc-10613314.creator: Abiodun B Idowu, Pushti Khandwala, Irene J Tan

pmc-10708357.title: Effect of Powder Bed Fusion Laser Sintering on Dimensional Accuracy and Tensile Properties of Reused Polyamide 11
pmc-10708357.creator: Urvashi F. Gunputh, Gavin Williams, Marzena Pawlik, Yiling Lu, Paul Wood
pmc-10708357.description: Polyamide 11 (PA11) is a plant-based nylon made from castor beans. Powder bed fusion laser sintering (PBF-LS) is an additive manufacturing process used for PA11 which allows for the reuse of the unsintered powder. The unsintered powder is mixed with virgin powders at different refresh rates, a process which has been studied extensively for most semi-crystalline polyamides.

pmc-10741017.title: In Vitro Activities of Oxazolidinone Antibiotics Alone and in Combination with C-TEMPO against Methicillin-Resistant Staphylococcus aureus Biofilms
pmc-10741017.creator: Audrey R N Ndukwe, Jilong Qin, Sandra Wiedbrauk, Nathan R B Boase, Kathryn E Fairfull-Smith, Makrina Totsika, Lene Karine Vestby
pmc-10741017.description: Infections caused by methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) are a global health concern. The propensity of MRSA to form biofilms is a significant contributor to its pathogenicity. Strategies to treat biofilms often involve small molecules that disperse the biofilm into planktonic cells. Linezolid and, by extension, theoxazolidinones have been developed to treat infections caused by Gram-positive bacteria such as MRSA.

pmc-10808482.title: Description of the vaginal microbiota in nulliparous ewes during natural mating and pregnancy: preliminary signs of the male preputial microbiota modulation
pmc-10808482.creator: Marta Barba, Marion Toquet, Empar García-Roselló, Jesús Gomis, Juan J. Quereda, Pedro González-Torres, Belén Carbonetto, Ángel Gómez-Martín
pmc-10808482.description: The vaginal microbiota plays a key role in animals’ health. Understanding its diversity and composition and associated changes occurring through the reproductive cycle represents valuable knowledge to disclose the mechanisms leading to dysbiosis and eventually to infection. Even if the human vaginal microbiota has been thoroughly studied, scarce research has been conducted on the vaginal microbiota of livestock.

pmc-11428405.title: Efficacy of short-term Peg-IFN α-2b treatment in chronic hepatitis B patients with ultra-low HBsAg levels: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-11428405.creator: Yuying Li, Siqi Yang, Cong Li, Zhenjie Ma, Mengmeng Zhang, Wenhang Zou, Zihao Wu, Haiyan Hou, Weixing Wang, Liying Zhu
pmc-11428405.description: PurposePeginterferon alfa-2b (Peg-IFN α-2b) has demonstrated superior efficacy over nucleos(t)ide analogs (NAs) in the treatment of chronic hepatitis B (CHB), particularly among patients with low levels of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg). This study aims to determine whether patients with ultra-low HBsAg levels (< 200 IU/mL) can achieve significantly higher clinical cure rates with abbreviated courses of Peg-IFN α-2b therapy.

pmc-11507089.title: Electroacupuncture Reduces Heart Rate and Perceived Exertion During a Bike Test: A Preliminary Analysis
pmc-11507089.creator: Emily Gaudet, Tristan Castonguay, Maryse Fortin, Geoffrey Dover
pmc-11507089.description: Background: Preliminary research suggests that acupuncture can improve cardiovascular function. The purpose of our study was to determine if electroacupuncture can improve performance and post-exercise recovery. Methods: Thirty-two healthy people participated in this study (14 men and 18 women, aged 23.6 ± 3.5 years). The first visit included baseline measurements.

pmc-11532434.title: Novel sulphur-selective method for simultaneous determination of thiram and asomate based on carbon dots and its application in fruits
pmc-11532434.creator: Lijun Wei, Mengdie Cai, Bixiao Zhou, Ping Yuan, Guowen Zhang, Xianglei Cheng
pmc-11532434.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Thiram (THI) and asomate (ASO) are frequently detected agrochemicals in food samples due to widespread use as fungicides. However, their detection suffers from matrix interference, or the necessity of derivatization before measurement. Integrating HPLC with a post-column carbon dots (CDs)–enhanced chemiluminescence (CL) system makes it possible to simultaneously separate and selectively detect ASO and THI in fruit samples free of derivatization and deep purification.

pmc-11604694.title: Input device matters for measures of behaviour in online experiments
pmc-11604694.creator: Matthew Warburton, Carlo Campagnoli, Mark Mon-Williams, Faisal Mushtaq, J. Ryan Morehead
pmc-11604694.description: Studies of perception, cognition, and action increasingly rely on measures derived from the movements of a cursor to investigate how psychological processes unfold over time. This method is one of the most sensitive measures available for remote experiments conducted online, but experimenters have little control over the input device used by participants, typically a mouse or trackpad.

pmc-13189500.title: Fasting Reveals the Effects of a Plant Extract‐ and Microalgae‐Derived Nutraceutical on Lipid Metabolism and Hepatic Physiology in Juvenile Sparus aurata Fed a Plant‐Based Diet

Juvenile Sparus aurata were fed three experimental diets for 90 days, followed by 14 days of feed deprivation.

pmc-13423815.title: Supramolecular dye polymers for aggregation-induced photocatalysis
pmc-13423815.creator: Marianna Barbieri, David Cappelletti, Luca Vaccarin, Marco Villa, Luca Catalano, Khai-Nghi Truong, Fabrizio Nestola, Elisa Pelorosso, Alessandro Aliprandi, Andrea Sartorel, Paola Ceroni, Francesca Arcudi, Luka Ðorđević
pmc-13423815.description: Aggregation can profoundly alter the excited-state properties of organic chromophores; however, crystalline supramolecular polymers are often targeted for photocatalytic conversion of solar energy due to favourable charge delocalization or exciton transport. Here we exploit aggregation as a strategy for organic chromophore rigidification to activate photocatalysis by stabilizing localized excited states.
